protocol.primary_acceptance: Against strongfixedbase, WERdiffCIupper<=0.01 and bothwholeCPU/wallcostdiffCIupper<0; also report cost-adjusted entropicCE and pairedreturn versus matchedrandom
protocol.random_order: SHA256 of fixed literal natural-cascade-2713 and source id, then choose sameK as learned; no target or futurebase output

protocol.scope: Actual natural speech-to-text generation by two frozen neuralmodels with a trained allocation head; no generatorweightupdates, speechsynthesis or originalHeptaneuron integration
